protocols.title: Hexarelin (5mg Vial) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Human study reference: roughly 1–2 mcg/kg IV and about 1.5 mcg/kg SC (~100 mcg for 70 kg). A 5 mg vial + 2 mL bacteriostatic water gives 2.5 mg/mL. Reference data only, not a use recommendation.

schedule.description: Source reports 1–2 mcg/kg IV and about 1.5 mcg/kg SC; approximate 100 mcg for a 70 kg participant.
